goalZh: 会读一份计划清单,说出每条计划和理由
canDoZh: 能读懂一份新年计划清单,说出每条计划和理由,并写出自己的三条

newItems.noteZh: 重音在第二个音节 im-POR-tant;美式口语里 -tant 的 t 常常很轻。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.zh: (写在新笔记本的第一页)我的新年计划

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: 1. Speak English with people every day. It's important!
lines.zh: 1. 每天和别人说英语。这很重要!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: 2. Go running every weekend. Running is fun!
lines.zh: 2. 每个周末去跑步。跑步很好玩!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: 3. Learn to swim. Ethan is going to be my teacher.
lines.zh: 3. 学会游泳。伊森要当我的老师。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: 4. Have a video call with Mom and Dad every Sunday.
lines.zh: 4. 每个星期天和爸妈视频。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I miss them, and they miss me!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: 5. Be Amy's Chinese teacher every week.
lines.zh: 5. 每周给艾米当中文老师。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And she can be my English teacher!
lines.zh: 她也可以当我的英语老师!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: 6. Only one coffee a day. (Really? I love coffee!)
lines.zh: 6. 一天只喝一杯咖啡。(真的吗?我那么爱喝咖啡!)

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: 7. Take a lot of pictures of Seattle.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: This is going to be a great year!

questions.prompt: 磊打算多久和爸妈视频一次?
questions.explainZh: 4. Have a video call with Mom and Dad every Sunday.(每个星期天。)

questions.prompt: 关于咖啡,磊的计划是什么?
questions.explainZh: 6. Only one coffee a day. (Really? I love coffee!)——他自己都不太相信能做到。
3. Learn to swim. Ethan is going to be my teacher.(艾米是要跟磊学中文。)

grammar.bodyZh: 计划清单常用“序号 + 动词原形”开头,省掉 I'm going to:1. Speak English every day. = I'm going to speak English every day.。后面用一句话说理由:It's important! / Running is fun!。表示频率的说法放在句末:every day、every week、every Sunday、every weekend。a day 表示“每天”:one coffee a day(一天一杯)。
